name: ShelterBox
summary: A UK disaster-relief charity (ShelterBox Trust, with 13 affiliates such as ShelterBox USA and Canada that raise money for it) that gives emergency shelter, household items and cash after disasters and conflict, directly and through local partners: tents, tarpaulins and toolkits, blankets, kitchen sets, solar lights, water carriers and mosquito nets, and in protracted crises mudbrick and more durable shelters. In 2025 it supported more than 231,000 people in 17 countries and territories.

spending.source: https://images.shelterbox.org/site-1/2026/08/ShelterBox-Annual-Report-2025.pdf (Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial activities p. 46 and note 4 p. 52: charitable activities £16.741m of total expenditure £21.584m, year to 31 December 2025; excludes raising funds £4.843m and gifts in kind £0.615m (note 2 p. 51), which are donors' resources. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS).)
